description: Mapa Geomorfológico E.1:50.000 - Hoja 929 - Canal de San Clemente is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Geológico y Minero de España [EXTINTO]. It belongs to the series 'Geological Map of Spain E. 1:50.000. (MAGNA50)'. Coverage: Instituto Geológico y Minero de España [EXTINTO]. The portal shows the English title as "Geomorphological Map E.1:50.000 - Sheet 929 - Canal de San Clemente" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Instituto Geológico y Minero de España [EXTINTO]. Its keywords include modelado antrópico, Geomorfología y Geología del Cuaternario, modelado glaciar y periglaciar, modelado poligénico, Sistemática de Estratigrafía, morfocronología. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.igme.es/condiciones-de-uso/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
